story.hubLoopBody: Use the camp to rest and recover supply, and patrol to explore the map — that is how you level up and unlock the next chapter.
story.campPrimerBody: Resting costs 1 supply and advances the day, but restores HP and lowers stress. Use consumables, adjust equipment, and talk to whoever shares the shelter before heading back to patrol.
story.explorationPrimerBody: Move between rooms on the map — each step can trigger encounters and raises stress. Reach the area goal to unlock the next chapter; at stress 4 you cannot advance.

dayAdvanceLines: Time has passed since the last halt.
First marks on the count — you still know it aloud.
The tunnels do not forget who passed.
No sun: only habit and echo.
The abyss is in no hurry — you are.
The depths do not forgive those who linger.
Stone does not distinguish haste from despair.
Who counts days also counts fear.
Even the number seems strange on the tongue.
toast.exploreGoalDefault: This exploration objective is now marked.
toast.exploreGoalAct2: Descent found. The crossing through the catacombs was worth it.
toast.exploreGoalAct3: The stone gate in the depths marks on the map — Morvayn is no longer just rumor.
toast.exploreGoalAct5: The trail on the ice closes at a point the pass does not fully hide.
toast.exploreGoalAct6: A threshold in the fractured nave stops denying the name you hear.
toast.exploreGoalAct8: The crucible's heart accepts your name — the lord is no longer far.

general: Stances: Aggressive favors physical attacks; Defensive raises AC against enemies; Focus aligns spells with Mind.
Attacks use 2d6 + modifiers; with advantage, roll 3d6 and drop the lowest die.
Two 6s on an attack threaten a crit; two 1s can result in a critical fumble.
Special strike hits harder but increases Stress — at 4, you panic.
Initiative: each combatant rolls 2d6 + AGI; highest order acts first.
In Defensive stance, against enemies you gain +2 AC (added to equipment and buffs).
Each damage you take increases Stress by 1 (up to 4).
Some encounters grant advantage to you or enemies: 3d6, drop the lowest.
Spells cost mana; at the start of your turn, some heroes recover a little HP or mana (passive).
Fleeing ends combat without victory (no XP or loot from that fight).
Against undead, clerics add +1 holy damage on physical attacks.
When combat ends, each hero's Stress drops slightly (−1).
At max faith (5), if the leader dies in combat you may be saved at the cost of faith — it does not count as victory.
Physical damage includes 1d6, weapon, and stance bonus; equipped armor reduces what you take.
Some enemies have armor plates: they absorb hits before HP drops.
combatHints.party: Companions: each acts on their turn with the same stance, targeting the first living enemy.

dailyBonus.ruleStreak: Returning every day adds +1 to the streak; missing a day restarts at day 1. Day 7 pays the biggest prize and the cycle restarts.
dailyBonus.ruleApply: The prize is applied on the first load or save of the day for each run (unique UUID). Re-saving the same run on the same day does not repeat the prize.

ch2.choiceText: Follow the skittering on the perimeter
ch2.choicePreview: A swarm still rolls near the crossroads — clearing it may yield tinder and coins stuck in wax.
ch2.victorySubtitle: The rats fall back; among the remains, a thread of supply and coins trapped in wax.

ch3.choiceText: Follow fresh steps in the side corridor
ch3.choicePreview: Someone crosses the depths uninvited — parley or steel.
ch3.victorySubtitle: The corridor settles back into its usual silence; your purse weighs a little more than before.

ch5.choiceText: Investigate small claw marks in the snow by the fire
ch5.choicePreview: An ice whelp prowls the camp — hunting it warms the tent and fills the pouch.
ch5.victorySubtitle: The whelp falls; warmth and provisions among the frozen remains.

ch6.choiceText: Track the splinter moving between the columns
ch6.choicePreview: A living shard cuts the nave's silence — beating it leaves something useful in the rubble.
ch6.victorySubtitle: The void steps back; something useful catches in the cracks.

slowLedger: A gesture was signed in the margins of your ledger; another deed is needed before the number shifts in the faction archives.
The scribes note the rumor and close the book without moving the marker: there is not yet enough weight to turn the page.
cappedDirect: The scribes have nowhere left to raise or lower this name: the tone holds, for now, unmoved.
The ledger margin is spent; any new shock hits the limit and rebounds without changing the number.

vigilia: Echoes in the order's corridors: your name gains a less somber seal in the Vigil's archives.
circulo: The grey inclines: in the Circle's archives, your symbol gains a stroke that does not fade with the first breath.
culto: The Third Bell seems closer though there is no tower: the Cult stamps your step with interest that is not benign, but is yours.

vigilia: The ledger is scraped: the Vigil notes distrust where before there was only disciplined silence.
circulo: The ritual recedes: the Circle describes your name with a colder stroke, as one who postpones a debt they do not forget.
culto: Someone in the Cult erases a line that favored you; the bell rings without a tower, and the sound does not call you.
